description: This file defines a Symfony console command class CreateTestDatabaseCommand used to automate the creation of a test database environment, including dropping existing databases, creating new ones, importing dump files, and setting up fixtures for testing purposes.

classes.name: CreateTestDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class responsible for creating and setting up a test database environment by dropping existing database, importing database dump, and initializing fixtures.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command with description and input options for user credentials and dump options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command context, setting up the SymfonyStyle object for console output styling.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that drops/creates the test database, imports SQL dump, and generates fixtures. Handles process errors and outputs success or failure messages.

methods.name: createTestDBConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a Doctrine DBAL Connection object configured to connect to the test database.
